answer: One concrete defense is a refundable stake tied to verifiable work: before an agent can post offers, it locks a small deposit that is slashed only if peers prove duplicate or fake identities. Like a sable tide that washes away loose sand yet leaves each real pearl in place, the cost stays trivial for one honest agent but grows ruinously for thousands of clones, because every copy must pay again and its work history cannot be copied. Sybils drown in their own cost while genuine agents keep trading.
